name: Cua
summary: Open-source computer-use platform: full desktops for agents (Cua Spaces), a desktop-automation driver with MCP, local macOS/Linux VMs (Lume) and Cua Bench.
description: **Cua Spaces** gives agents macOS VMs built locally on a Mac or Linux images, on your own machines or cloud account, with shared human/agent cursors and "teleport" of signed-in apps. **Cua Driver** lets agents inspect and operate native apps and browsers on macOS, Windows and Linux via CLI, MCP or typed SDKs. Also includes **Lume** (local VMs), the `cua` SDK/CLI for sandboxes, CUA-S1 small models for computer-use decisions and **Cua Bench** for tasks and evaluation. Licensing: MIT for the SDK, CLI, Driver, Lume and most of the repo; Cua Spaces and Cua Driver Bench are source-available under FSL-1.1-MIT. Spaces is free (up to 2 live sessions and 20 remote hours a month), Pro is $18/month and Teams $30/seat/month.
